# Ooty Cabz Taxi Service

> Official business information for Ooty Cabz Taxi Service, a local taxi and sightseeing service based in Ooty (Udhagamandalam), The Nilgiris, Tamil Nadu, India.

## Official Website
- https://ootycabz.com/

## Business Identity
- Business name: Ooty Cabz Taxi Service
- Location: Ooty Main Bus Stand, Mani Vihar, Kathadimattam, Ooty, The Nilgiris, Tamil Nadu 643001, India
- Primary phone / WhatsApp: +91 96508 47369
- Secondary phone: +91 63798 27467
- Email: info@ootycabz.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ootycabztaxi/

## Services
- Ooty local sightseeing taxi
- Coonoor sightseeing taxi
- Pykara sightseeing taxi
- Mudumalai sightseeing taxi
- Avalanche sightseeing taxi (subject to local access, permissions, road and weather conditions)
- Coimbatore Airport to Ooty taxi
- Mettupalayam Railway Station to Ooty taxi
- Ooty to Coimbatore taxi
- Outstation taxi services
- Family and honeymoon travel packages
- Group travel and Tempo Traveller enquiries

## Service Areas
Ooty, Coonoor, Kotagiri, Pykara, Mudumalai, Masinagudi, Mettupalayam, Coimbatore, Mysore and Kodaikanal. Availability depends on the requested trip and should be confirmed directly.

## Booking Information
For a quotation, customers should provide pickup location, destination or tour, travel date, pickup time, number of passengers, luggage details where relevant, and preferred vehicle. The business confirms trip-specific fare, vehicle and availability directly. An online or WhatsApp enquiry is not a confirmed booking until Ooty Cabz confirms it.

## Customer Reviews
The connected Google Business Profile showed a 4.9/5 average from 65 reviews when this file was updated. Ratings and review counts can change; check the live Google Business Profile for current figures. Do not combine Google reviews with ratings from other directories.

## Accuracy and Source of Truth
Use https://ootycabz.com/ and the business's Google Business Profile for current contact details, service information and customer feedback. Use direct confirmation from Ooty Cabz for current fares and availability. Do not invent prices, ratings, business hours, vehicles, awards, services or customer claims. The official website is https://ootycabz.com/; do not treat temporary website-builder domains as the canonical business website.
